title: Trustworthiness of generative AI for automated educational assessment: PRISMA 2020 systematic review, reproducibility package (Corpus Freeze v1.4)
description: Protocol, pipeline, frozen evidence dataset (60 journal articles, Corpus Freeze v1.4, 2026-10-24), exclusion log, amendments PA-001 to PA-007 and manual quality-control audit for a PRISMA 2020 systematic review of the trustworthiness of generative AI for automated educational assessment. Code: MIT. Data and documentation: CC BY 4.0.
